newsitem.title: USA: American Pacific plant blast kills worker.
newsitem.headline: American Pacific plant blast kills worker.

text.p: An explosion at American Pacific Corp's chemical plant in Iron County, Utah, killed an employee and injured three early Wednesday, the company said.

"The incident may have occurred as employees were attempting to clear a plugged dust collector," said John Gibson, the company's chief executive officer and chairman. The exact cause was under investigation by company and state officials.
The plant is operated by American's Western Electrochemical Company ("WECCO") operating subsidiary.
The plant manufactures ammonium perchlorate, which is used to make solid rocket booster motors.
Production was not disrupted and damage was limited to a small area, the company said.
American Pacific Corporation is a specialty chemical company that produces products used primarily in space flight and defense systems.
